errors.evidence: The description does not mention the legend or what the different colored lines represent (i.e., the risk categories 'Decreased Risk' and 'No Effect OR Increased Risk').
The green line starts at an ADE score of exactly 0.5, not 0.52. The description correctly identifies the starting point of the orange line at the same location as 0.50.
The green line clearly decreases to an ADE score of 0.0 at x=1.0, not 0.14.
The orange line clearly increases to an ADE score of 1.0 at x=1.0, not 0.94.
